programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kemi är Magi
programme.desc: Hank blir Max och Phoebes nya kemilärare. När han av en olyckshändelse äter kalkonmackor som får honom att somna så måste tvillingarna använda sina krafter för att hjälpa honom genomföra en presentation och behålla sitt jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fult Spel i Hejaklacken
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när bara en av dem blir uttagen till cheerleader-laget. Max vinner en tävling där priset är en månads gratis pizza, och måste övertyga sin familj att han inte fuskade.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thunder-Van
programme.desc: Hank tar hem familjens Thunder-Van från Metroburg för att Phoebe ska kunna fortsätta sin superhjälteträning. När alla fyra barnen smyger sig in i bilen för att utan lov ta en tur ger Hank dem en åktur de aldrig kommer att glömma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Konsten att Sälja Konst
programme.desc: Phoebe får hjälp av Billy med ett konstprojekt, men får veta att han stulit föremålet från ett museum. Nu måste de samarbeta med Max för att ta sig in och lämna tillbaka det innan någon märker det.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Driving on Three Wheels
programme.desc: A high-speed chase of a stolen sports car takes place, police attend a violent domestic dispute and a suspect arrested with a sex trade worker accuses police of racism.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Bad Fortune
programme.desc: A high-rolling, high-priced fortune-teller is slaughtered, and detectives must decipher a bizarre set of clues that weave superstition and brutality in equal measure.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Double Cross

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1103

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 105

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 602

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 603

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Romantic Meal

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: De Hemsökta Thundermans Del 1

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Mammas Superfan

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was convicted of rape, sodomy and aggravated sexual battery and sentenced to three life terms in prison. He maintained his innocence. After years in prison and writing countless letters, he finally found someone who believed him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. Rose's disappearance remained a mystery, until a tiny clue is found years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Killing Room
programme.desc: When Scott Dunn goes missing, police spray his bedroom with Luminol and uncover a scene of horrific violence. Now investigators face a daunting task: proving that Scott Dunn had been murdered without a body, a witness or a murder weapon.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Trace
programme.desc: After being admitted to the hospital with unexplained bleeding, 11-month-old Chad Shelton dies. Investigators and scientists frantically search for a cause when others from the same house fall ill.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stepping Hill

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jordens Undergång
programme.desc: När en supervulkan djupt under Swellview börjar visa tecken på att få ett utbrott blir Henry och Ray övertygade om att världen kommer gå under. Piper är övertygad om att hon är glutenintolerant.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hjärtligt Galet

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superstängt

programme.title: Dora and Friends: Into The City!
programme.desc: När Doras kompis Alana skadar sig. Så måste Dora och hennes vänner ställa upp som ett kompislag i en springtävling som går igenom hela staden.

programme.title: Dora and Friends: Into The City!
programme.desc: När de är ute och campar träffar Dora och hennes vänner en drake med smak för marshmallows. Han har ont i magen. Nu måste han komma i form för att kunna försvara feernas värld.

programme.title: Dora Utforskaren
programme.desc: Dora och Boots måste gå med en korg godsaker till mormor Abuela, men dom måste akta sig för räven Swiper på vägen dit!

programme.title: Dora Utforskaren
programme.desc: Dora fixar ett födelsedagskalas när Boots fyller år!

programme.title: Kom Igen Diego!
programme.desc: Diego förvandlar ett räddningspaket till en hängglidare och flyger iväg för att fånga Chinta precis innan hon ramlar i vattnet.

programme.title: Kom Igen Diego!
programme.desc: Sengångaren Sammy är på besök hos Diego på djurräddningscentret när ett nödrop inkommer. En lerflod är på väg mot trädet där mamma och bebis sengångare är.

programme.title: Blaze och Monstermaskinerna
programme.desc: Starla ska ställa upp med sin gris Kvicke i det stora grisrallyt Nöffnöff 500. Men Crusher bestämmer sig för att fuska, och skickar iväg Kvicke långt utanför staden. Kommer Blaze, AJ och Starla hinna rädda Kvicke innan rallyt börjar?

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Kapten Dille tar hjälp av kycklingarna för att komma åt en nyckel till en skattkista. Det hela slutar dock med att kadetterna måste dem! // Rods lillebror Romeo är lite ängslig, men blir snabbt modig när han måste rädda sin familj!

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Ett fallande träd hotar Ellies hem. Kadetterna ber henne att sova över och hon hjälper till att vägleda deras räddningsinsats. // Fiffi Fladder utmanar Rod för att se vem som är snabbast. När Frasse försöker att fuska måste Rod rädda Fiffi!

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Della hjälper Björn Robinsson utforska Virvelöns hemliga grottor. Kadetterna måste fly innan de blir instängda för evigt! // Frasse fuskar för att vinna Virvelöns stora plaskravinlopp och kadetterna måste rädda de andra deltagarna.

programme.title: Dora Utforskaren
programme.desc: Benny måste reparera ett hål i sin varmluftsballong. Han behöver riktigt stark tejp!

programme.title: iCarly: iDejt - Sam och Freddie
programme.desc: Carly går in för att medla i ett gräl mellan Sam och Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie och Sam till Carly för att få hjälp varenda gång de grälar. När hon nu blivit involverad, hur ska Carly kunna dra sig ur situationen?

programme.title: iCarly: iNTE uthärdligt
programme.desc: Freddies mamma upptäcker Sams och Freddies relation efter att Gibby, nu föremål för Sams hämnd, gjort upp planer för att splittra dem. Kommer Carly att kämpa för Sam och Freddie, eller hjälpa Gibby att få dem att göra slut?

programme.title: iCarly: Jag älskar dej
programme.desc: Carly säger åt Sam och Freddie att prova varandras favorithobbies. Under tiden stöter Spencer på sin gamla barnvakt och bjuder ut henne på middag. Efter att de återfallit i sina gamla roller, kommer de att kunna fortsätta vara tillsammans?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly försöker imponera på sin nya pojkvän genom att verka smartare än hon är. Under tiden försöker gänget hitta ett nytt ställe där T-Bo kan bo, efter det att han blivit utsparkad från Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: iMöter rikets första dam
programme.desc: En högt uppsatt statlig myndighet börjar utreda iCarly-gänget efter att de hackat sig in i ett säkerhetsnätverk, för att kunna ge Carlys pappa ett födelsedagskalas online. Gästartist - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: iTån och Fat Cakes
programme.desc: Gänget, minus Carly, tar med Sam till den kanadensiska Fat Cake-fabriken, och upptäcker sedan att Sam inte får komma tillbaka till USA. Under tiden får Carly bekymmer i badkaret medan hon gör sig klar inför sin dejt.

programme.title: iCarly: iSynproblem
programme.desc: Efter att ha blivit "dissad" i en intervju om iCarly, försöker Freddie visa sin kreativa sida genom att webb-sända iCarly i 3D. Spencer anställer en assistent som han inte har råd att betala.

programme.title: iCarly: iTabbar 2: Electric Tabbaloo
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skådespelaren som spelar Rex i Victorious, återvänder för att djup-intervjua stjärnorna i iCarly, och visa deras superroliga tabbar och bortklippta scener. Gästartist: Rex från Victorious.

programme.title: iCarly: iFortfarande galen
programme.desc: Efter att ha fått veta att Nora Dershlit kan komma att släppas ut ur fängelset, gör iCarly- ungdomarna vad de kan för att se till att deras gamla kidnappare ska förbli bakom galler. Under tiden upptäcker Freddies mamma den verklige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iGå One Direction
programme.desc: Carly får en smittsam sjukdom och råkar av misstag göra så att en av medlemmarna i bandet One Direction blir sjuk. Under tiden tvingas Spencer träna en liten tjej som avskyr träning.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splinter på Rymmen / Maskotstriden
programme.desc: Donnies nybyggda Turtle Tank försvinner spårlöst. // För att kunna köpa en present åt Splinter, måste Turtles besegra de tuffa maskotarna på Times Square.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Sköldpaddor i Bur / Minotauruslabyrinten
programme.desc: Leo besegrar Raphs idol och blir ny världsmästare i brottning. // Klara mutantlabyrinten på max 30 minuter och få gratis Pizza.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Myggbekämparna
programme.desc: Turtles försöker att hitta ett sätt att lösa New Yorks mutantmygg-problem.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den Längsta Striden / Hypno! Del Två
programme.desc: Turtles försöker att se deras idol åka skateboard samtidigt som de stoppar ett inbrott. // Hypno-flodhästen återvänder och skapar kaos på Aprils skoldans.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Gumbussen / Fru Gullegull
programme.desc: Leo, Mikey och April undersöker ett mystiskt spöke som hemsöker ett snabbköp. // April och bröderna tvingar Raph att möta sin största skräck...en gullig kanin från ett barnprogram.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: I Klistret / Al Återvänder
programme.desc: Efter en otursam lim-olycka tvingas Turtles att kämpa mot ett helt gäng skurkar. // Turtles första musikaliska uppträdande störs av Albearto och hans animatroniska armé!

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Den Lila Jackan / Pizzabråket
programme.desc: En ondskefull teknik-klubb lockar till sig Donnie och hans tekniska snille med en jättefin, lila satinjacka. // Det är Pizza-veckan, årets bästa vecka, men Turtles favoritpizzerior försvinner mystiskt en efter en.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Turtle-Butlern / Varm Soppa: Spelet
programme.desc: Donnies nya A.I. uppfinning tar över högkvarteret och gör livet komplicerat för Raph, Mikey och Leo. // Mikey ger sig ut på ett solouppdrag för att hämta ett klassiskt Lou Jitsu videospel.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: De Ondskefulla Mutanternas Legion
programme.desc: Baron Draxum samlar ihop en grupp skurkar för att besegra Turtles!

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Avgiften / Bullhop
programme.desc: En så enkel sak som att lämna tillbaka en DVD kan bli jättesvårt i ett helgalet New York. // Saker strular till sig när Turtles försöker att hjälpa en deppig mutant.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Hjärnsmälta / Tryffel Och Trubbel
programme.desc: Donnie får mer att han vågat hoppas på när han förstorar sina bröders intelligens. // Efter en bisarr transformation, blir Mikey och Fläsk Färs bästa kompisar.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Dead Men Don't Do Aerobics
programme.desc: A TV aerobics instructor tries to get the Bundys in shape, but instead he becomes sedentary and dies of a heart attack after eating junk food.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck Saves the Day
programme.desc: Kelly and Bud need to raise money for concert tickets for themselves, so Bud sells Al as a camping guide, and Kelly cheats at a poker game with Peggy's friends.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Tooth or Consequences
programme.desc: A toothache forces Al to see Marcy's dentist, a divorced man who devotes as much of his time to his work as he does to his young female dental assistant. At the same time, Al pressures Peggy to cook him just one square meal.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: He Ain't Much, But He's Mine

programme.title: South Park: Den siste meheecanen

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Being Kara

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Girls Night In

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: First Date

programme.desc: Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: On a windy Kansas night in 1995, a mysterious fire swept through the home of a prominent doctor. In the debris, investigators found evidence which told them how the fire started.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: July 28, 1996. A bloated, decomposing corpse is hauled out of the English Channel. There is little to go on. Police don’t know whether this is a murder, a suicide, or just a tragic accident.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: A woman is charged with starting the fire that killed the two sleeping children of her lesbian lover. Then, a woman pleads guilty to first-degree manslaughter after stabbing a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: 3 police officers were murdered in Shepherds Bush in 1966. After the killing they went on the run and a manhunt ensued. One assailant survived 3 months on the run.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: London's Haunted Viaduct Tavern
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane explore the massive gin palaces in the haunted Viaduct Tavern in London.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna Räddar Valinda / Valparna Räddar ett Stort ben

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kapten Klantskalle
programme.desc: Captain Man bestämmer sig för att hålla en tävling där vinnarna får en guidad visning av hans hemliga högkvarter. Men när några av Henrys vänner vinner tävlingen blir han orolig över hur han ska hålla sin identitet hemlig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hinkfällan
programme.desc: Henry och Charlotte vill berätta för Jasper att Henry egentligen är Kid Danger. De bestämmer sig för att sätta honom på prov för att se om han verkligen skulle klara av att hålla deras hemlighet säker.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry i Dåligt Sällskap 1

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry i Dåligt Sällskap 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Flickvän
programme.desc: Jaspers flickvän kommer till staden på besök, och får sova över hemma hos Charlotte. Hon blir dock snabbt svartsjuk och blir övertygad om att Charlotte är kär i Jasper. Charlotte börjar undra om Jaspers flickvän har en skruv lös.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Takten Sitter I

programme.desc: Henrys planer inför den stora skolfesten blir lite komplicerade när han även måste gå på festen som Kid Danger. När det sedan börjar köra ihop sig rejält på festen tvingas han ta ett drastiskt beslut.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry och Hackspettarna
programme.desc: När Pipers basketbollstränare slutar övertalar hon Henry att ta över tjänsten. Samtidigt som han försöker få laget i vinnarform tvingas han kämpa mot styrelsen för Swellviews Ungdoms-Rörelse, som är allt annat än förtjusta i hans metoder.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kapten Man på Semester
programme.desc: När Kapten Man blir inbjuden till sin kusins bröllop, lämnar han Swellview i Henry och Charlottes händer. Men det dyker snart upp problem när de tvingas ta hand om stadens problem helt själva.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsskojaren

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In June 1984, 15-year-old cheerleader Kirsten Costas was lured out and stabbed five times by jealous classmate Bernadette Protti in Orinda, California. The case inspired the TV movie Death of a Cheerleader.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle

programme.title: Kate & Leopold

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.title: Bull

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Customers locked inside a bar are forced to fight monsters.

programme.title: Risky Business

programme.title: Mr. Mom

programme.title: Over the Top

programme.title: Blades of Glory

programme.title: Failure to Launch

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: When Army Major Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders) is framed for treason, Reacher discovers she's the target of a massive government conspiracy.

programme.title: Varsity Blues

programme.title: Go

programme.title: The Long Goodbye

programme.title: Saint Jack

programme.title: Death Wish

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)

programme.title: Double Team

programme.title: Universal Soldier: The Return

programme.title: Mona Lisa Smile

programme.title: The Ugly Truth

programme.title: Rachel Getting Married
programme.desc: When Kym returns to the Buchman family home for her sister Rachel's wedding, she brings a long history of personal crises, family conflict, and tragedy. Rated -R

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: A creative writing assignment yields complex results between a teacher and his talented student.

programme.title: Alice, Darling

programme.title: Trauma Center

programme.title: Forrest Gump

programme.title: That Thing You Do!

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
